explication: Vesper is an Android AI control center for Flipper Zero. The principal workflow is: a user submits text, voice, or image context; the app sends the request to an OpenRouter-backed agent; risk and permission checks govern tool execution; commands and payloads reach Flipper over BLE/CLI/RPC; results return to the UI and are audited. The graph also preserves documented payload, signal, device, glasses, and operations capabilities. Some UI-to-domain wiring is inferred from documented architecture and filenames; sampled excerpts most directly confirm payload, BLE, safety, audit, and bridge boundaries.
